# Beta121 — Away targets and restart input validation

- Recheck current home presence and room occupancy for every managed device
  plan. A cached Home/Comfort plan cannot retain its higher target after a
  live change to Away, including installations without sleep/alarm settings.
- Hold new Automatic/PID starts and output increases while configured home
  presence is unresolved. Restored or unavailable Away trackers cannot
  authorize heating with a fallback Home target. Valid explicit presets and
  Manual control remain explicit choices; settings remain editable.
- Apply the same profile check at native-command, retry and upstream supply
  boundaries. Existing shutdown, minimum run/off and acknowledgement
  protections continue to apply. Temporary presence holds recover when valid
  data returns, without consuming retries or requiring a manual Continue.
- Recheck Automatic heating/cooling and humidity demand immediately before
  sending a native command. A profile change during storage or queue waits
  cannot send an obsolete ON or full-output target. Normal Automatic
  hysteresis is preserved.
- Exclude measurements explicitly marked as restored by Home Assistant from
  current room averages and control inputs. Remaining valid sensors still
  contribute; a real new reading restores the source automatically.

Regression tests reproduce the Away 10°C / Home 21°C / room 19°C startup
case and the effect of an old 8°C restore placeholder on a real 22°C room
average. Restart checks also confirm that a positive saved PID integral
cannot start heat above a valid current target. Native transport tests cover
an Automatic command crossing to Away at 18.6°C with a 16°C heating target.

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. No new setting is required.
